purpose: Establish the authoritative Emberfall v0.2 repository/source baseline and determine which parts of the existing SLAY! prototype can be reused without importing its swap-match-3 rules.
constraints: Work only in an isolated branch or worktree.
Treat the v0.2 specification and current handoff branch as design authority.
Treat implementation/emberfall-latest-source as a legacy prototype; reuse architecture only after review.
Do not import swap-match-3 board rules into v0.2.
Do not bypass unresolved P0 decisions.
Do not treat simulated persona review as human playtest evidence.
No unapproved merge, publish or deploy.
No secrets in commits or logs.
risks: R1: prototype gameplay rules materially diverge from v0.2.
R1: handoff branch has no Android source/build, so Android gates are not applicable yet.
R1: legacy Gradle wrapper script/JAR are absent.
R1: independent EFB-000 review remains pending on the current PR #4 head; every new head supersedes previous review and CI evidence.

Legacy prototype architecture and rule divergence are evidenced from source.
Toolchain/build applicability is explicit; missing build is not reported as PASS.
WBS and Maestro task bundle IDs/dependencies validate.
ADR counts and QA discrepancy are recorded.

GateRunner output includes VERIFIED evidence, runner identity, ran_on_sha and log hashes.
